s1_reservation_detail: The rationale behind restrictions to types is not clear in A (also not tooo clear in B unless you know the data models). However B is much clearer on the WHY of the mapping logic, which A lacks.
s1_useful_detail: The "think aloud" in going from Analysis to Design to Development
s1_missing_detail: Links to source schemas in human-readable form would have helped so I not only read but also judge decisions made (such as type restrictions but also whether the two sources actually use the same coordinate system so the similarity makes sense at all).
s1_comments: B has clearly more info and seems more useable. However, if humans need to provide all that information that can in practice often be a blocker. Either most fields are optional and don't get filled, or they are mandatory but then people do not create the artifact at all as they get annoyed.
s2_reservation_detail: In this case, to be both A and B answer the HOW, but not the WHY. To reduce reservations I need to understand the WHY.
overall_preference_reason: B is for sure more detailed. however my concern is getting people to actually fill it - see comment before
